decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with vertical through contacts extend the firm's core competence in structured packaging wafers and match its strategic direction toward multifunctional substrates, and with only a year on the market there is no shortfall against aspirations that would trigger problemistic search, so management keeps it.

Carrier wafers for handling smaller-diameter wafers are a low-cost extension of the established offer and fit the push toward reusable carriers and thin-wafer handling, so the modest resources they tie up are easily carried by existing slack while results mature.
